notes.title: Runes of Aereal November Update
notes.notes:
Hi there,

Another month has gone by, and yet again, some more nice updates for the Runes of Aereal.

From this build onwards, the heroes have separate starter decks.  Each hero has its own speciality like poison, fire, electricity, etc...  

I introduced some new cards for that like Lucifer, Penetration and Escalation.  The escalation card is also the first card you can upgrade, where the upgrade doesn't increase the effect, but rather decreases the cost of the card.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359104/6a1f3edbeb48e52ff0f29bf2b03bc07dd80f23a3.png

Also, some new artifacts were added.

The serpents medallion will make sure you cannot be poisoned, whereas the blood thorn dagger will make sure you cannot be set on fire.  The whispfire lantern will double the damage of a lucifer card.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359104/b7aadc117aa9e15fd50d9ef4ff080a0419118570.png

Another trait has also been implemented : the innate trait.  When you have that trait, you can pick 1 card that is always drawn as the first card when you start the battle.  In the interface where you manage the cards, an extra icon appears.  You can only mark the icon on 1 card.  If you remove the card from your deck, it will disappear.  When upgrading the card, it's also clearly marked so you can deliberately upgrade that one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359104/0b03238ccf46ff1bdb434a909577728bff756af8.png

Lastly, a new boss creature has been introduced : the dragon.  That makes for the fourth boss creature all together now: the phoenix, the scorpion, the griffon & the dragon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359104/6db44d6870364ba0b49ea8698e4a28ee5d417eb0.png

I hope you like these changes & I will keep you posted.

Cheers!

Bart

notes.title: Runes of Aereal October Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It's october 2023, so time for a new update on the Runes of Aereal.
A lot of work has been done this time, mostly based on feedback of the community.

In terms of consistency of look and feel, I've changed quite some visual assets.  The spellbooks and crafting items have had an overhaul, as you can see in the screenshot below.  I've added hints for them as well, where as that wasn't the case up until now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359104/9227fa3148a314be99b47405071e7519d93492a0.png

The crafting interface has also been improved, and now allows to upgrade multiple scrolls in one session.  A lot of pesky bugs have been fixed here.

Also, the runes have had an upgrade, and I've provided them with a name and some extra lore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359104/0b5e629bb447c5696c1158d6599b0ba8cffe92cf.png

Based on community feedback, I also revamped the shop interface. Basically, made it much easier.  Instead of working with baskets, there's the possiblity to sell items just by clicking on it, and also buying items while clicking on them, as long as there are sufficient funds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359104/15ba45ff5a8c962ff526426abcf687ce7a64af31.png

A new boss creature has been introduced : the Phoenix.  A nice bird like creature with nice animations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359104/fa6851d254fd9a5a2278a92a3dd12e0731fbce93.png

I really got a lot of feedback from playtesters, community and marketing (thanks guys!).
I'm on a mission to evaluate and implement a lot of them, and a lot of work has been done here already.  Especially all of those bugs you don't encounter if you created the game, and don't assume people are going to do things out of the ordinary.

Next up is to have some kind of tutorial.  I see a lot of people struggling with the mechanics, so a tutorial will be a useful addition, in my opinion.  That's to come in november, so stay tuned people!

Cheers!

notes.title: Runes of Aereal September Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I'm excited to share with you, the new stuff added to Runes of Aereal for the month of September '23!

First of all, there's a brand new island named Fairie Glen.  A nice new island with 6 new cities you can explore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359104/72d08323c0b1b04010f125182eb69c3677c0b264.png

Next to that, some more collectables were added to the game, this time the 7 deadly sins.  Some nice new cards to gather as you play the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359104/e2a183ab947ef8e310f3dfe9b62386967be4c39d.png

Another new trait has been implemented : the Blind trait.  As the name suggests it's the ability to blind all enemies every 8 turns.  There's a nice new button in the interface, and also an indicator by the creature to indicate it is blind.  When a creature is blind, it will miss you when it shoots a projectile.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359104/c60da09f79abe123eac103d52b43cddc5b2d36b0.png

Lastly I would like to mention that achievements were also added to the game.  Not too many for the moment, but much more to come.  I was just setting up the system, and testing some achievements as I move along with the development.  I hope you like them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359104/bb30208ba3544c410fc33bc6d64447a5711c7fa3.png

Apart from that of course a lot of polishing, bugfixing, but also some new female incantations in case you pick a female hero, some new cards, and the timetraveler trait, which lets you go back to the start of the battle every 20 turns.

I'll be bringing more goods next month, so make sure keep a look out.

Cheers!
